changeSet.author: sample
changeSet.comment: Department names are unique regardless of case; replaces the case-sensitive constraint.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE departments DROP CONSTRAINT uk_departments_name;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_departments_name_lower ON departments (lower(name));
changeSet.rollback:
DROP INDEX uk_departments_name_lower;
ALTER TABLE departments ADD CONSTRAINT uk_departments_name UNIQUE (name);
